history.summary: A brand-new (2026 TOP) 99-yr leasehold 2BR in an integrated development just 430m from Buona Vista interchange, at the heart of One-North. Excellent location, but asking $2,469 PSF is ~3% above the $2,390 new-launch median, the appreciation data carries new-launch bias, and the 99-yr clock starts now at a premium PSF.
history.rating_rationale: Top-tier location — integrated mixed-use, 430m to Buona Vista (EWL+CCL interchange), in the One-North job hub — and a deep 275-txn series confirm strong demand. But asking $2,469 PSF is ~3% above the $2,390 median (per search, 2BR average ~$2,250, so this stack is rich), has_new_launch_bias=true means the appreciation is developer-inflated, and a fresh 99-yr lease at peak pricing leaves limited 5-7yr upside. Score_1000 of 602 is good but the entry price already captures the catalyst.
red_flags: Asking $2,469 PSF above the $2,390 new-launch median — paying top of market
New-launch bias on appreciation — headline rate is developer-inflated, not resale-proven
Fresh 99-yr lease entered at premium PSF — thin appreciation headroom
$1.78M for a 721 sqft 2BR is a high PSF entry
catalysts: Integrated development 430m from Buona Vista interchange (EWL+CCL)
One-North tech/biomedical hub — strongest job-driven demand in the west
New, well-located product with deep buyer interest (275 txns)
